svg.text: FALSE case (not drawn): two Bundle By Name nodes build Contactor = Fail with the reply as its note, and
PackVolt = Skipped, note "not measured - contactors did not close". Refnum and error tunnels pass straight across.
SYS:CONT OPEN sits OUTSIDE the Case Structure on purpose — the safe state must run on every path, pass or fail.
A skipped step is recorded as Skipped, never as Pass. A skipped test read as passed is how bad units ship.
